name: ciphera
description: Privacy-first real-time messaging platform with client-side encrypted payload workflows.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ciphera/types && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/validation && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/contracts && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/api
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace @ciphera/types && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/validation && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/contracts && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/crypto && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/api && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @ciphera/types && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/validation && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/contracts && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/crypto && npm run build --workspace @ciphera/web
scripts.test: npm run build:all && npm run test:unit --workspace @ciphera/api && npm run test:unit --workspace @ciphera/validation && npm run test:unit --workspace @ciphera/crypto && npm run test --workspace @ciphera/web
